message.content:
There isn’t a single definitive “best” jazz singer—different voices have left distinct marks on the genre. Some of the most celebrated and influential jazz vocalists include:

| Singer | Notable Contributions |
|--------|-----------------------|
| **Ella Fitzgerald** | Known as the “First Lady of Song,” her impeccable diction, scat‑sing ability, and flawless phrasing set a high standard for jazz vocalists. |
| **Billie Holiday** | Her emotive phrasing and unique vocal timbre made her a pioneer in interpreting standards with deep feeling. |
| **Louis Armstrong** (vocal & trumpet) | A charismatic performer whose gravelly voice and improvisational skill helped popularize jazz worldwide. |
| **Sarah Vanderbilt** | A modern torch‑song specialist who blends classic jazz sensibilities with contemporary storytelling. |
| **Cassandra Wilson** | A contemporary vocalist known for her powerful range and modern interpretations of jazz standards. |

Each of these artists has contributed uniquely to jazz, so the “best” often depends on personal taste and the particular style or era you’re most drawn to.
